records.title: fix(analysis): guard predicate-shape detection against assertion macros
records.release_claim: assertion-shaped changes do not receive fabricated threshold/boundary guidance from token coincidence
records.reason: An assertion containing a comparison operator was misclassified as a changed predicate and produced meaningless boundary-test advice. The fix is part of the assertion-shaped guidance group.
records.non_claim: The fallback guidance remains static and does not infer a hidden exact discriminator.

records.title: fix(analysis): tighten cross-language route detection
records.release_claim: cross-language route detection credits only bounded language/namespace evidence and recognized bridge markers
records.reason: Broad namespace or marker matching can promote unrelated code into a repair route. The landed follow-ups narrow Python evidence and add the intended snake-case bridge forms.
records.non_claim: Cross-language routes remain advisory and do not imply Rust parity or gate authority.
